sn56.10:1.1: _Tiracchānakathā_ literally means “animal talk”. The Pali word for animal, _tiracchāna_ has the sense of “moving horizontally”, and “low talk” is that which does not elevate.
sn56.10:1.2: _Bhavābhava_ does not mean “existence and non-existence” but is a distributive compound, “this or that state of existence”. Indian religious texts are full of discussions about different heavens and hells.
